item.title: PromptKey 0.1.0 (20)
item.description: - The brief microphone popup is gone. The usual Listening indicator appears when audio reaches PromptKey. - A microphone start that receives no audio times out and offers recovery instructions. - PromptKey avoids decoding identical audio again after an empty Apple Speech result. If a final result cannot be used after a partial was displayed, that session's recording and partial are available for recovery. - If writing to the clipboard fails, PromptKey stops before sending Paste and preserves any newer copy.
